items.quote: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:
items.claim: The text says the children of Israel followed Moses' instruction and asked the Egyptians for silver jewellery, gold jewellery and clothing.
items.object: jewels of silver, jewels of gold, and raiment
items.mechanism: acting according to the word of Moses

items.quote: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they lent unto them such things as they required.
items.claim: The text says the Egyptians gave the Israelites what they asked for because the LORD made the Egyptians look on them with favour.
items.mechanism: divine favour given by the LORD in the sight of the Egyptians

items.claim: The text says the Israelites stripped the Egyptians of their goods.
items.mechanism: acquisition of goods through the lending described just before
